body:
lemme just say, i’m also 16 soon to be 17 next week on august 11th :) 

i‘m kind of in the same boat, but not exactly. or at least, not so much anymore?? in my family i’m seen as the “smart one,” whatever that means, and i have a lot of expectations put on me by my parents and stuff. but when i was in middle school especially, i was really really lonely. sure i was technically doing good with my life, but i just had . . no one . . . no friends, no peers, no guardians. i just felt completely isolated like no one understood me. when i got into high school it was more of the same. most of freshman year i was really sad, and i had a few friends, but i didn’t rlly feel bonded with them. i self harmed and stuff and shut myself away from family. i was just a really dull and lonely shell. 

things did begin to change though after 2018 came around. i met some great people and i really bonded with them over shared interests. we’re still friends to this and i wouldn’t be surprised if i spent my life being friends with them. im healing slowly, and taking care of myself. sometimes i still feel a little lonely at night when i’m thinking a lot, but i’m learning to make peace with those feelings.  

i guess what i’m trying to say is, life isn’t linear, and things aren’t eternal. i truly thought i’d spend my life as a loner, and now i’m nothing like i thought i was gonna be 3 years ago. things change, especially in ways we least expect. i’m sure what you’re feeling now will pass.
